summary: Frontend-only verification of (A) new turnout donut on admin overview and (B) signed PDF/CSV report downloads on the admin election Results tab. Both features work as specified. Regression items (student stat cards, 'Elections by state', 'Built and developed by Hriata_khuptong' credit) all present.
critical_code_review_comments: Direct deep link to /app/admin/elections/{eid} redirects unauthenticated/non-matching routing to '/'. The admin election detail is actually served at /app/elections/{eid} (observed after clicking from list). Consider a dedicated /app/admin/elections/:id route or redirect for consistency with the admin IA.
